messages:
carmen: Hi all — accepted the invite but I still can't see the org's private repos or rerun Actions (403).
sam: @carmen could you paste the banner text/error from Actions?
carmen: The workflow run UI shows `403 Forbidden` and when I open the org page it says I'm a member of 'Redwood Inference - Sandbox' not 'Redwood Inference'. I clicked the invite link from the onboarding email though.
it-bot: heads up: make sure you accepted the invite for the correct org. We run a sandbox org for contractors and test accounts. Docs: https://redwood.dev/onboard/github#org-invites
idp-admin: that explains it — sandbox is a separate org with no access to main private repos. Do you still have the original invite link?
carmen: i only have the onboarding email; it has a tiny badge that says 'redwood-inference/sandbox' in the URL and i missed it. my bad.
sam: no worries. two options: we can cancel the sandbox membership and resend the real org invite, or map your current GH account to the main org if the email matches. Which GitHub account did you accept with?
carmen: i used carmen.dev@gmail.com (personal). my work email carmen@redwood.ai is not on that account. i already created a draft PR from that personal account against a repo in the main org though.
platform-eng: mapping the personal account to the main org is possible but only if you add the work email and enable 2FA on that account. Otherwise we'll revoke the sandbox invite and send a fresh invite to your work account.
carmen: i'd rather not lose the PR. what's the recommended path?
idp-admin: recommended: add carmen@redwood.ai to Settings -> Emails on the personal account, verify it, enable TOTP 2FA, then go to the main org invite link and accept SSO. We'll then run a manual SSO mapping sync and move you from the sandbox org to the main org. That preserves PR ownership.
carmen: ok added work email and enabled TOTP. clicked the main org invite but it still shows 'pending member' — maybe because i accepted sandbox earlier?
sam: i can clean up the sandbox invite on our side. i'll remove you from sandbox so accepting the main org invite will complete. ping when done.
platform-eng: cleanup done — removed sandbox membership and re-sent the main org invite to the email on your personal account. also queued a manual SSO mapping.
idp-admin: mapping finished. invited you into teams: eng, product-infra. temporarily granted repo:platform write so you can re-run the workflow.
carmen: re-ran the Actions job and it accepted! i can see the private repos now :tada: PR is still under my personal account too.
sam: awesome. when you have a sec add your SSH key to the SSO-linked account and drop a quick intro in #new-hires-intros. Also we recommend using your work account for future invites to avoid the sandbox confusion.
carmen: will do — thanks for the quick help and for preserving the PR history! :raised_hands:
